description: One recursively indexed JSON array item. Its UUIDv7 identity is independent of its numeric JSON Pointer locator and order.

columns.name: empty_json
columns.description: Exact whitespace inside this item's empty object or array value. Omitted for non-empty containers and scalars.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stable UUIDv7 identity assigned by Lix on create.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: The JSON value kind represented by this array item.

columns.name: order_key
columns.description: Lexically sorted lowercase hex bytes, nonempty with an even length and no trailing 00. Defaults to 80; equal keys sort by member key or array UUID, not insertion time.

columns.name: parent_id
columns.description: Stable identity of the containing array.

columns.name: prefix_json
columns.description: Exact JSON whitespace before this array item. Omitted when empty.

columns.name: scalar_json
columns.description: The JSON scalar value. Omitted when kind is object or array.

columns.name: scalar_text
columns.description: Exact noncanonical scalar spelling, used only while it agrees with scalar_json.

columns.name: suffix_json
columns.description: Exact whitespace after the value and before its comma or closing bracket. Omitted when empty.
